writeLease.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators=(',',':'); SHA-256

requiredImplementation: _read_generation_seal requires exact keys schemaVersion,generation,ledgerRelativePath,previousSealSha256,createdAt,sealSha256
generation is positive int and bool invalid; ledgerRelativePath is exactly control/control-ledger-v1.sqlite3
previousSealSha256 is lowercase 64-hex; generation 1 requires zero hash and later generations require nonzero and not the current seal hash
createdAt parses as aware +09:00 and validates after conversion to ZoneInfo Asia/Tokyo with fold zero
sealSha256 is lowercase 64-hex and equals the canonical hash over exactly the other five fields
every mismatch raises NEWS_GRASP_ENTRY_LEDGER_CORRUPT without mutation
refactor the four existing CREATE TABLE bodies into canonical constants shared by _create_schema and schema verification so constraint text cannot drift
at the start of _verify_connection require exact non-internal sqlite_master objects: four tables metadata,invocations,slots,events and no user view,trigger,extra table or explicit index
compare whitespace-normalized sqlite_master SQL for all four tables against the canonical CREATE SQL, preserving every PRIMARY KEY, UNIQUE and CHECK clause
compare PRAGMA table_info exact ordered cid/name/type/notnull/default/pk signatures for all four tables

compare PRAGMA index_list/index_info exact canonical automatic indexes: metadata PK(key); invocations PK(invocation_id) plus UNIQUE(wal_event_sha256); slots composite PK(schedule_id,issue_date,slot_kind); events UNIQUE(event_sha256); no other index
schema mismatch is NEWS_GRASP_ENTRY_LEDGER_CORRUPT before metadata, event-chain or materialized-state trust
add a defaulted DurabilityOps create-once publication callable without changing _write_json positional signature used by the test-owned wrapper

for 0002-imported.json only, publish the complete fsynced temp without replacing an existing destination: Windows os.rename no-replace; non-Windows same-directory os.link then temp unlink, both mapping destination-exists to FileExistsError
all other JSON leaves retain the existing replace behavior
on loser FileExistsError, _write_json cleans its temp and returns typed WAL_FINALIZE_FAILED; mark_imported then reads the winner
factor one imported-parity validator and use it for pre-existing marker, race loser and verify/iter paths; require invocationId, rawArgv, rawArgvSha256, writer and predecessor equality
winner and losers all return the exact winner event, no public overwrite and no temp residue
keep public recover signature and observed_at validation, then acquire the existing cross-process _bootstrap_lock for the entire health check, journal decision and phase machine
move the existing body into one private locked helper without changing crash hook names, journal phases or durability operations
the winner performs recovery; a waiter acquires after completion, observes healthy plus COMMITTED journal and returns RECOVERY_NOT_REQUIRED with the same recoveryId/newGeneration
lock releases on every exception so existing crash-resume tests continue to work; existing bounded busy timeout semantics remain

verification.newNodesCommand: py -3.12 -m pytest --noconftest -q tests/test_news_grasp_cleanroom_s1_entry.py -k 'generation_seal_exact_schema_fails_closed or sqlite_exact_schema_fails_closed or imported_marker_concurrent_publish_is_immutable or concurrent_recovery_has_single_authority'
verification.security: NEWS_GRASP_CLEANROOM_SECURITY_SCAN_V1 on exact changed production paths; denied/private/secret/external/network counts zero
other: git diff --name-only exact subset of two-file lease

commitPolicy.paths: exact changed subset of two-file writeSet
commitPolicy.message: fix: close S1 schema and authority gaps

causalRetryCondition: one implementation attempt and one ordered verification chain; stop on first non-Green
delivery: production paths only, hashes/bytes, commit and exact verification evidence
